prompts.prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Asset type: production animation sprite atlas. Reference image is the existing snow leopard kitten with blue eyes, pale spotted fur and thick spotted tail; preserve its exact face, fur markings, proportions and detailed painterly illustration style. Create ONE transparent sprite sheet, EXACTLY 4 columns by 5 rows, 20 equal square cells, no gutters, no visible grid or labels, ideally 1536 by 1920 pixels. Exactly one same-sized full snow leopard kitten with blue eyes, pale spotted fur and thick spotted tail per cell, facing RIGHT in a gentle side three-quarter profile; consistent head, torso and tail dimensions, stable camera, no character swapping. First THREE rows contain 12 successive subtly differing frames of ONE COMPLETE naturally coordinated walk cycle, read left to right then next row: alternate grounded paws/feet, progress leg joints in small increments, stable torso and gentle tail follow-through; frame 12 loops seamlessly into frame 1, no jumping in these rows. Last TWO rows contain eight leap postures in order: lower crouch, deepest crouch, hindleg push off, legs extend at takeoff, forelegs reach forward with hindlegs tucked, legs extend for landing, flexed landing crouch, recovery stand. These must visibly change limb articulation, not just reposition the same picture. In each cell center torso horizontally, keep body size identical and all paws at or above a common floor at 91 percent cell height; leave enough transparent margins for ears and tail. Do not animate world-space translation inside the sheet; code moves the character. Entire atlas background truly transparent with no glow halo, ground, shadow, scenery, checkerboard, border or text. Anatomy must be coherent, no extra legs, no duplicated bodies, no clipping across cell boundaries. Match reference identity closely, not cartoon flat vectors.
